falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 80% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed support holding; a break below this level invalidates the structural bottom thesis and suggests continuation lower, not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and systemic stress, contradicting the 'HOLD' signal's assumption of orderly consolidation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve steepens by more than 40 basis points (from current levels) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Rapid curve steepening in this context would signal recessionary de-risking or bank stress, breaking the pattern's macro assumption that the August bottom marked a durable economic inflection point

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
